ownership_reason: Only the per-row running total inspects individual values; once a NaN item has entered the running total, Math.min/Math.max carry NaN into both extremes and the highest total reached before it (25 on the trigger) is lost, so the fold over the rows, the range assembly and the pass-through hops cannot recover [0, 25] with a one-line change, and a CategoryDataset cannot be pre-filtered in one line. The project's totals skip NaN elsewhere (DatasetUtilities.calculateStackTotal, StackedAreaRenderer.getStackValues, iterateRangeBounds, the TableXYDataset findStackedRangeBounds, the stacked-range NaN tests) and the trigger adds Double.NaN expecting the cumulative range to stay [0, 25].
